rows.st: Dijalo tse qadileng tereing di behelwa bethe ho tloha kgweding ya pele eo di ka lokelang ho falliswa ka yona. Latela mesebetsi ya kgwedi. Motsu o bolela hore sejalo se tswela pele kamora {month} {year}.
rows.ts: Swibyariwa swa tireyi swi vekeriwa mubedo ku sukela eka n'hweti yo sungula leyi swi nga lulamelaka ku byariwa ha yona. Landzela mintirho ya n'hweti. Nseve wu vula leswaku xibyariwa xi ya mahlweni endzhaku ka {month} {year}.

rows.english: The calendar file works with Google Calendar and Apple Calendar. Tasks land as whole-day entries on the first of their month — this plan works in months, not exact days — with a reminder three days before.
rows.zu: Ifayela lekhalenda lisebenza ne-Google Calendar ne-Apple Calendar. Imisebenzi ivela njengezinto zosuku lonke ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yayo — lolu hlelo lusebenza ngezinyanga, hhayi ngezinsuku eziqondile — nesikhumbuzi ezinsukwini ezintathu ngaphambi kwalokho.
rows.st: Faele ya khalendara e sebetsa le Google Calendar le Apple Calendar. Mesebetsi e hlaha e le diketsahalo tsa letsatsi lohle letsatsing la pele la kgwedi ya yona — moralo ona o sebetsa ka dikgwedi, eseng matsatsi a tobileng — ka kgopotso matsatsi a mararo pele ho moo.
rows.ts: Fayili ya khalendara yi tirha na Google Calendar ni Apple Calendar. Mintirho yi nghena yi ri swiendlakalo swa siku hinkwaro eka siku ro sungula ra n'hweti ya yona — pulani leyi yi tirhisa tin'hweti, a hi masiku lama kongomeke — ni xitsundzuxo masiku manharhu ku nga si fika nkarhi wolowo.
rows.ve: Faela ya khaḽenda i shuma na Google Calendar na Apple Calendar. Mishumo i dzheniswa sa mafhungo a ḓuvha ḽoṱhe nga ḓuvha ḽa u thoma ḽa ṅwedzi wayo — pulane iyi i shuma nga miṅwedzi, hu si maḓuvha o livhaho — na khumbudzo maḓuvha mararu phanḓa.

rows.english: The printed plan shows each crop growing in its bed across the months, like the app, plus pictures of what you can pick.
rows.zu: Uhlelo oluprintiwe lubonisa isitshalo ngasinye sikhula embhedeni waso ngezinyanga, njenge-app, kanye nezithombe zalokho ongakukha.
rows.st: Moralo o hatisitsweng o bontsha sejalo ka seng se hola betheng ya sona dikgweding, jwaloka app, le ditshwantsho tsa se ka kgwang.
rows.ts: Pulani leyi kandziyisiweke yi komba xibyariwa xin'wana ni xin'wana xi kula emubedweni wa xona eka tin'hweti, ku fana ni app, ni swifaniso swa leswi u nga swi khaka.
rows.ve: Pulane yo ganḓiswaho i sumbedza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi tshi khou aluwa kha mubete watsho kha miṅwedzi, u fana na app, na zwifanyiso zwa zwine na nga kaṋa.

rows.english: It also has what to buy, monthly tick-off jobs and a harvest record.
rows.zu: Iqukethe nalokho okufanele kuthengwe, imisebenzi yenyanga ongayimaka uma isiqediwe nerekhodi lesivuno.
rows.st: E boetse e na le se lokelang ho rekwa, mesebetsi ya kgwedi e tshwauwang ha e phethilwe le rekoto ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Yi tlhela yi va ni leswi faneleke ku xaviwa, mintirho ya n'hweti yo fungha loko yi endliwile ni rhekhodo ya ntshovelo.
rows.ve: I dovha ya vha na zwine zwa tea u rengwa, mishumo ya ṅwedzi ya u swaya musi yo itwa na rekhodo ya khaṋo.

rows.english: Picking dates for trees and animals must be confirmed locally; plants and housing with unknown dates stay listed on the plan. The separate Future harvest PDF has the ten-year graph and age groups. Calendar & jobs gives concise wall sheets in your chosen paper size. Record animal numbers and care checks in the site survey; confirm production months in this plan. The detailed reference includes the full bed-by-bed plan, benchmarks, buying lists, guidance, monthly field sheets and harvest records.
rows.zu: Izikhathi zokukha ezihlahleni nokuthola imikhiqizo yezilwane kufanele ziqinisekiswe endaweni; izitshalo nezindlu zezilwane ezinezinsuku ezingaziwa zihlala zibhalwe ohlelweni. I-PDF yesivuno sesikhathi esizayo ehlukile inegrafu yeminyaka eyishumi namaqembu obudala. Ikhalenda nemisebenzi kunikeza amaphepha odonga afingqiwe ngosayizi wephepha owukhethile. Bhala izinombolo zezilwane nokuhlolwa kokunakekelwa kwazo ocwaningweni lwendawo; qinisekisa izinyanga zokukhiqiza kulolu hlelo. Imininingwane yokubhekisela ihlanganisa uhlelo oluphelele lombhede ngamunye, izilinganiso zokubhekisela, izinhlu zokuthenga, iziqondiso, amaphepha emisebenzi enyanga namarekhodi esivuno.
rows.st: Matsatsi a ho kga difateng le ho fumana dihlahiswa tsa diphoofolo a tlameha ho netefatswa sebakeng sena; dimela le matlo a diphoofolo a nang le matsatsi a sa tsejweng a dula a thathamisitswe moralong. PDF e arohaneng ya kotulo ya nakong e tlang e na le kerafo ya dilemo tse leshome le dihlopha tsa dilemo. Khalendara le mesebetsi e fana ka maqephe a makgutshwane a leboteng ka boholo ba pampiri boo o bo kgethileng. Ngola palo ya diphoofolo le tlhahlobo ya tlhokomelo phuputsong ya sebaka; netefatsa dikgwedi tsa tlhahiso moralong ona. Tshupiso e qaqileng e kenyelletsa moralo o felletseng wa bethe ka nngwe, ditekanyetso tsa tshupiso, manane a ho reka, tataiso, maqephe a kgwedi a tshimong le direkoto tsa kotulo.
rows.ts: Masiku ya ku kha emirhini ni ku kuma swikumiwa swa swiharhi ma fanele ku tiyisisiwa endhawini; swimila ni tindlu ta swiharhi leswi nga ni masiku lama nga tivekiki swi tshamaka swi xaxametiwile eka pulani. PDF ya ntshovelo wa nkarhi lowu taka leyi hambaneke yi ni girafu ya khume ra malembe ni mintlawa ya vukhale. Khalendara ni mintirho yi nyika maphepha yo koma ya ku hayeka ekhumbini hi sayizi ya phepha leyi u yi hlawuleke. Rhekhoda nhlayo ya swiharhi ni ku kambela nhlayiso eka vulavisisi bya ndhawu; tiyisisa tin'hweti ta vuhumelerisi eka pulani leyi. Nkombiso wa vuxokoxoko wu katsa pulani leyi heleleke ya mubedo wun'wana ni wun'wana, swipimo swa nkombiso, minxaxamelo ya ku xava, swiletelo, maphepha ya masimu ya n'hweti ni tirhekhodo ta ntshovelo.
rows.ve: Maḓuvha a u kaṋa kha miri na u wana zwibveledzwa zwa zwipuka a tea u khwaṱhisedzwa henefho; zwimela na nnḓu dza zwipuka zwi re na maḓuvha a sa ḓivhei zwi dzula zwo ṅwalwa kha pulane. PDF yo fhambanaho ya khaṋo ya tshifhingani tshi ḓaho i na girafu ya miṅwaha ya fumi na zwigwada zwa vhukale. Khaḽenda na mishumo zwi ṋea mashatari mapfufhi a u nembeledza kha luvhondo nga saizi ya bammbiri ye na nanga. Rekhodani tshivhalo tsha zwipuka na tsedzuluso dza ndondolo kha ṱhoḓisiso ya fhethu; khwaṱhisedzani miṅwedzi ya vhubveledzi kha pulane iyi. Tshiko tsha zwidodombedzwa tshi katela pulane yo fhelelaho ya mubete muṅwe na muṅwe, zwipimo zwa tshiko, mutevhe wa u renga, ngeletshedzo, mashatari a ṅwedzi a tsimuni na rekhodo dza khaṋo.

rows.english: Usually 4–6 weeks in warm conditions; cold conditions can take about twice as long (8–12 weeks). Start checking from the first readiness month and transplant when seedlings and the bed are ready. The bed calendar uses the middle month as its working transplant date; update the planting if the seedlings are delayed.
rows.zu: Ngokuvamile amasonto angu-4–6 uma kufudumele; uma kubanda kungathatha isikhathi esiphindwe cishe kabili (amasonto angu-8–12). Qala ukuhlola kusukela enyangeni yokuqala ezingalungela ngayo, bese utshala kwenye indawo lapho izithombo nombhede sekulungile. Ikhalenda lemibhede lisebenzisa inyanga ephakathi njengosuku lokuhlela lokutshala kwenye indawo; buyekeza ukutshala uma izithombo zibambezelekile.
rows.st: Hangata ke dibeke tse 4–6 ha ho futhumetse; ha ho bata ho ka nka nako e ka bang habedi (dibeke tse 8–12). Qala ho hlahloba ho tloha kgweding ya pele eo dimela di ka lokelang ka yona, mme o di fallisetse tshimong ha dimela le bethe di se di loketse. Khalendara ya dibethe e sebedisa kgwedi e bohareng e le nako ya ho fallisetsa tshimong bakeng sa moralo; ntjhafatsa ho lema haeba dimela di diehile.
rows.ts: Hi ntolovelo i mavhiki ya 4–6 loko ku kufumela; loko ku titimela swi nga teka nkarhi lowu phindhiweke kwalomu ka kambirhi (mavhiki ya 8–12). Sungula ku kambela ku sukela eka n'hweti yo sungula leyi swimilana swi nga lulamelaka ha yona, kutani u swi byala kun'wana loko swimilana ni mubedo swi lulamile. Khalendara ya mibedo yi tirhisa n'hweti ya le xikarhini ku hlela ku byala swimilana kun'wana; pfuxeta ku byala loko swimilana swi hlwerile.
rows.ve: Kanzhi ndi vhege dza 4–6 musi hu tshi dudela; musi hu tshi rothola zwi nga dzhia tshifhinga tshi ṱoḓaho u vha kavhili (vhege dza 8–12). Thomani u sedzulusa u bva kha ṅwedzi wa u thoma une zwimelana zwa nga lugela ngawo, ni zwi sudzulusele tsimuni musi zwimelana na mubete zwo lugela. Khaḽenda ya mibete i shumisa ṅwedzi wa vhukati sa tshifhinga tsha u pulana u sudzulusela tsimuni; khwinisani u ṱavha arali zwimelana zwo lenga.

rows.english: Published optimum-condition maturity endpoints are planning slots, not promises. Before any successor is sown or transplanted, confirm the previous crop is finished and the bed is actually clear; crops may mature later.
rows.zu: Izikhathi zokuvuthwa ezishicilelwe zezimo ezifanele ziyizikhala zokuhlela, hhayi izithembiso. Ngaphambi kokuhlwanyela noma ukutshala isitshalo esilandelayo kwenye indawo, qinisekisa ukuthi esangaphambili sesiqediwe nombhede awusenalutho ngempela; izitshalo zingavuthwa kamuva.
rows.st: Dinako tsa ho butshwa tse phatlaladitsweng bakeng sa maemo a matle ka ho fetisisa ke dibaka tsa ho rera, ha se ditshepiso. Pele o jala kapa o fallisetsa sejalo se latelang tshimong, netefatsa hore sejalo sa pele se fedile mme bethe e hlile e hlwekile; dijalo di ka butshwa hamorao.
rows.ts: Minkarhi ya ku wupfa leyi kandziyisiweke ya swiyimo leswinene ngopfu i tindhawu ta ku hlela, a hi switshembiso. Loko xibyariwa lexi landzelaka xi nga si byariwa kumbe ku susiwa xi byariwa kun'wana, tiyisisa leswaku xibyariwa xa khale xi herile ni leswaku mubedo a wu na xona hakunene; swibyariwa swi nga wupfa endzhaku ka nkarhi.
rows.ve: Mafhelelo a u vhibva o ganḓiswaho a zwiimo zwavhuḓi vhukuma ndi zwikhala zwa u pulana, a si mafulufhedziso. Phanḓa ha u zwala kana u sudzulusela tshiliṅwa tshi tevhelaho tsimuni, khwaṱhisedzani uri tshiliṅwa tsho fhiraho tsho fhela na uri mubete a u na tshiliṅwa itsho zwa vhukuma; zwiliṅwa zwi nga vhibva nga murahu ha tshifhinga.

rows.english: Source {weight} before sowing in {month}. This is the mapped area multiplied by the published {rate} kg/ha field-rate range. {instruction} Confirm the sowing method and cultivar with the supplier; no germination allowance is added.
rows.zu: Thola {weight} ngaphambi kokuhlwanyela ngo-{month}. Lokhu yindawo esebalazweni ephindwe ngesilinganiso sokuhlwanyela sasensimini esishicilelwe esingu-{rate} kg/ha. {instruction} Qinisekisa indlela yokuhlwanyela nohlobo lwe-cultivar nomthengisi; akufakwanga umkhawulo wokubhekelela ukuhluma.
rows.st: Fumana {weight} pele o jala ka {month}. Sena ke sebaka se mmapeng se atisitsweng ka tekanyo ya ho jala tshimong ya {rate} kg/ha e phatlaladitsweng. {instruction} Netefatsa mokgwa wa ho jala le cultivar le mofani; ha ho keketso ya ho dumella ho mela e kentsweng.
rows.ts: Kuma {weight} u nga si byala hi {month}. Leyi i ndhawu leyi nga emepeni leyi andzisiweke hi mpimo wa ku byala ensin'wini wa {rate} kg/ha lowu kandziyisiweke. {instruction} Tiyisisa ndlela ya ku byala ni cultivar ni muphakeri; a ku engeteriwanga mpimo wo pfumelela ku mila.
rows.ve: Wanani {weight} phanḓa ha u zwala nga {month}. Itshi ndi tshikhala tshi re kha mapa tsho andiswaho nga tshikalo tsha u zwala tsimuni tsha {rate} kg/ha tsho ganḓiswaho. {instruction} Khwaṱhisedzani maitele a u zwala na cultivar na murengisi; a hu na nyengedzo ya u katela u mela yo engedzwaho.

rows.english: Confirm the local row layout before deciding how many are needed.
rows.zu: Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kwemigqa kwendawo ngaphambi kokunquma ukuthi kudingeka ezingaki.
rows.st: Netefatsa tlhophiso ya mela ya lehae pele o etsa qeto ya hore ho hlokahala tse kae.
rows.ts: Tiyisisa ku hleriwa ka mintila ya ndhawu u nga si teka xiboho xa leswaku ku laveka swingani.
rows.ve: Khwaṱhisedzani nzudzanyo ya mitalo ya henefho phanḓa ha u dzhia tsheo ya uri hu ṱoḓea zwingana.

rows.english: The mapped area holds about {positions} plants at the spacings this plan uses. This is not a guaranteed seedling order and it allows nothing for plants that do not take; ask your supplier what they advise for this crop.
rows.zu: Indawo esebalazweni ithatha izitshalo ezingaba ngu-{positions} ngezikhala ezisetshenziswa yilolu hlelo. Leli akulona i-oda lezithombo eliqinisekisiwe futhi alibhekeli izitshalo ezingabambi; buza umthengisi wakho ukuthi weluleka ukuthini ngalesi sitshalo.
rows.st: Sebaka se mmapeng se nka dimela tse ka bang {positions} ka dikgeo tse sebediswang moralong ona. Sena ha se odara e netefaditsweng ya dimela tse nyane ebile ha se dumelle dimela tse sa tshwareng; botsa mofani wa hao hore o eletsa eng bakeng sa sejalo sena.
rows.ts: Ndhawu leyi nga emepeni yi teka kwalomu ka {positions} wa swimila hi mipfhuka leyi pulani leyi yi yi tirhisaka. Leyi a hi oda ya swimilana leyi tiyisisiweke naswona a yi pfumeleli swimila leswi nga khomiki; vutisa muphakeri wa wena leswi a swi tsundzuxaka hi xibyariwa lexi.
rows.ve: Tshikhala tshi re kha mapa tshi fara zwimela zwi ṱoḓaho u vha {positions} nga vhukati vhune pulane iyi ya vhu shumisa. Iyi a si oda yo khwaṱhisedzwaho ya zwimelana nahone a i kateli zwimela zwi sa khomi; vhudzisani murengisi waṋu zwine a zwi eletshedza nga tshiliṅwa itshi.

rows.english: Buying ready-grown seedlings? Source them only when the bed and seedlings are ready; the planning window is {window}. {quantity}
rows.zu: Uthenga izithombo esezikhulisiwe? Zithole kuphela lapho umbhede nezithombo sekulungile; isikhathi sokuhlela singu-{window}. {quantity}
rows.st: O reka dimela tse nyane tse seng di hodisitswe? Di fumane feela ha bethe le dimela di se di loketse; nako ya moralo ke {window}. {quantity}
rows.ts: U xava swimilana leswi se swi kurisiweke? Swi kume ntsena loko mubedo ni swimilana swi lulamile; nkarhi wa ku hlela i {window}. {quantity}
rows.ve: Ni khou renga zwimelana zwo no alusiwaho? Zwi waneni fhedzi musi mubete na zwimelana zwo lugela; tshifhinga tsha u pulana ndi {window}. {quantity}

rows.english: This one-time starter's tray-sowing month ({month}) has passed, so buying ready-grown seedlings is the remaining route.
rows.zu: Inyanga yokuhlwanyela ethreyini ({month}) yalesi siqalo sesikhathi esisodwa isidlulile, ngakho ukuthenga izithombo esezikhulisiwe yiyona ndlela esele.
rows.st: Kgwedi ya ho jala tereing ({month}) ya qalo ena ya hang feela e fetile, kahoo ho reka dimela tse seng di hodisitswe ke tsela e setseng.
rows.ts: N'hweti yo byala ethireyini ({month}) ya masungulo lawa ya kan'we ntsena yi hundzile, kutani ku xava swimilana leswi se swi kurisiweke hi yona ndlela leyi saleke.
rows.ve: Ṅwedzi wa u zwala kha thireyi ({month}) wa mathomo aya a luthihi wo fhira, zwenezwo u renga zwimelana zwo no alusiwaho ndi yone nḓila yo salaho.

rows.english: Raising your own instead? Source packet seed before the {month} tray-sowing month, use its tray-sowing rate, and sow trays in {month}.
rows.zu: Uzozikhulisela ezakho esikhundleni salokho? Thola imbewu yephakethe ngaphambi kwenyanga yokuhlwanyela ethreyini engu-{month}, sebenzisa isilinganiso sayo sokuhlwanyela ethreyini, bese uhlwanyela amathreyi ngo-{month}.
rows.st: O ikgodisetsa tsa hao ho e na le hoo? Fumana peo ya pakete pele ho kgwedi ya ho jala tereing ya {month}, sebedisa tekanyo ya yona ya ho jala tereing, mme o jale diterei ka {month}.
rows.ts: U kurisa swa wena ematshan'weni ya swona? Kuma mbewu ya phakete ku nga si fika n'hweti ya {month} yo byala ethireyini, tirhisa mpimo wa yona wo byala ethireyini, kutani u byala tireyi hi {month}.
rows.ve: Ni khou alusa zwaṋu vhudzuloni hazwo? Wanani mbeu ya phakhethe phanḓa ha ṅwedzi wa {month} wa u zwala kha thireyi, shumisani tshikalo tshayo tsha u zwala kha thireyi, ni zwale thireyi nga {month}.

rows.english: Confirm a locally appropriate row layout before buying planting material; the catalog does not have both verified spacing axes needed for an exact quantity. Plan to establish it in {month}.
rows.zu: Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kwemigqa okufanele indawo ngaphambi kokuthenga izinto zokutshala; ikhathalogi ayinazo zombili izilinganiso zezikhala eziqinisekisiwe ezidingekayo ukuze kutholakale ubuningi obuqondile. Hlela ukuyitshala ngo-{month}.
rows.st: Netefatsa tlhophiso ya mela e loketseng sebaka sena pele o reka thepa ya ho lema; khathaloko ha e na mahlakore a mabedi a dikgeo a netefaditsweng a hlokahalang bakeng sa bongata bo nepahetseng. Rera ho e lema ka {month}.
rows.ts: Tiyisisa ku hleriwa ka mintila loku faneleke endhawini u nga si xava swo byala; khathaloko a yi na matlhelo hamambirhi ya mipfhuka lama tiyisisiweke lama lavekaka eka nhlayo leyi kongomeke. Hlela ku xi sungula hi {month}.
rows.ve: Khwaṱhisedzani nzudzanyo ya mitalo yo teaho henefho phanḓa ha u renga zwishumiswa zwa u ṱavha; khathalogo a i na masia oṱhe mavhili a vhukati o khwaṱhisedzwaho a ṱoḓeaho kha vhunzhi ho livhaho. Pulanani u tshi ṱavha nga {month}.

rows.english: Living planting material — the mapped area holds about {positions} {unit} at the spacings this plan uses. This is not a guaranteed buy quantity and it allows nothing for material that does not take; ask the supplier what they advise for this crop. Get it close to planting in {month}, then follow the supplier's or your local handling advice. No general storage advice is assumed here.
rows.zu: Izinto zokutshala eziphilayo — indawo esebalazweni ithatha cishe {positions} {unit} ngezikhala ezisetshenziswa yilolu hlelo. Lokhu akulona inani lokuthenga eliqinisekisiwe futhi akubhekeli izinto ezingabambi; buza umthengisi ukuthi weluleka ukuthini ngalesi sitshalo. Kuthole sekuseduze nokutshala ngo-{month}, bese ulandela iseluleko somthengisi noma sendawo sokukuphatha. Akucatshangwa iseluleko esivamile sokugcina lapha.
rows.st: Thepa e phelang ya ho lema — sebaka se mmapeng se nka hoo e ka bang {positions} {unit} ka dikgeo tse sebediswang moralong ona. Sena ha se bongata ba ho reka bo netefaditsweng ebile ha se dumelle thepa e sa tshwareng; botsa mofani hore o eletsa eng bakeng sa sejalo sena. E fumane haufi le nako ya ho lema ka {month}, ebe o latela keletso ya mofani kapa ya lehae ya ho e hlokomela. Ha ho keletso e akaretsang ya ho boloka e nahanwang mona.
rows.ts: Swilo leswi hanyaka swo byala — ndhawu leyi nga emepeni yi teka kwalomu ka {positions} {unit} hi mipfhuka leyi pulani leyi yi yi tirhisaka. Leyi a hi nhlayo yo xava leyi tiyisisiweke naswona a yi pfumeleli swilo leswi nga khomiki; vutisa muphakeri leswi a swi tsundzuxaka hi xibyariwa lexi. Swi kume kusuhi ni nkarhi wo byala hi {month}, kutani u landzela switsundzuxo swa muphakeri kumbe swa ndhawu swo swi khoma. A ku tekiwi switsundzuxo swo angarhela swa ku hlayisa laha.
rows.ve: Zwishumiswa zwi tshilaho zwa u ṱavha — tshikhala tshi re kha mapa tshi fara zwi ṱoḓaho u vha {positions} {unit} nga vhukati vhune pulane iyi ya vhu shumisa. Uhu a si vhunzhi ho khwaṱhisedzwaho ha u renga nahone a vhu kateli zwishumiswa zwi sa khomi; vhudzisani murengisi zwine a zwi eletshedza nga tshiliṅwa itshi. Zwi waneni tsini na u ṱavha nga {month}, ni kone u tevhedza ngeletshedzo ya murengisi kana ya henefho ya u zwi fara. A hu humbulelwi ngeletshedzo yo angaredzaho ya u zwi vhulunga fhano.

rows.english: Source packet seed before the {month} sowing month. Sow straight into the ground in {month} for about {positions} plants at the spacings this plan uses. Use the packet's crop-specific direct-sowing rate and germination guidance; field spacing alone cannot tell you how much seed to buy.
rows.zu: Thola imbewu yephakethe ngaphambi kwenyanga yokuhlwanyela engu-{month}. Hlwanyela ngqo emhlabathini ngo-{month} ukuze uthole izitshalo ezingaba ngu-{positions} ngezikhala ezisetshenziswa yilolu hlelo. Sebenzisa isilinganiso sokuhlwanyela ngqo nesiqondiso sokuhluma esiqondene nalesi sitshalo esisephaketheni; izikhala zasensimini zodwa azikwazi ukukutshela ukuthi uthenge imbewu engakanani.
rows.st: Fumana peo ya pakete pele ho kgwedi ya ho jala ya {month}. Jala ka kotloloho mobung ka {month} bakeng sa dimela tse ka bang {positions} ka dikgeo tse sebediswang moralong ona. Sebedisa tekanyo ya ho jala ka kotloloho le tataiso ya ho mela e tobileng sejalo sena e paketeng; dikgeo tsa tshimong feela di ke ke tsa o bolella hore o reke peo e kae.
rows.ts: Kuma mbewu ya phakete ku nga si fika n'hweti ya {month} yo byala. Byala hi ku kongoma emisaveni hi {month} leswaku ku va ni kwalomu ka {positions} wa swimila hi mipfhuka leyi pulani leyi yi yi tirhisaka. Tirhisa mpimo wa ku byala hi ku kongoma ni swiletelo swa ku mila leswi kongomaka xibyariwa lexi leswi nga eka phakete; mipfhuka ya le nsin'wini ntsena a yi nge ku byeli leswaku u fanele u xava mbewu yo fikela kwihi.
rows.ve: Wanani mbeu ya phakhethe phanḓa ha ṅwedzi wa {month} wa u zwala. Zwalani nga ho livhaho mavuni nga {month} uri hu vhe na zwimela zwi ṱoḓaho u vha {positions} nga vhukati vhune pulane iyi ya vhu shumisa. Shumisani tshikalo tsha u zwala nga ho livhaho na ngeletshedzo ya u mela ya tshiliṅwa itshi zwi re kha phakhethe; vhukati ha zwimela tsimuni vhu vhuṱhe a vhu koni u ni vhudza uri ni renge mbeu nngafhani.

rows.english: Source direct-sown or tray seed before the named sowing month; the source does not provide a universal procurement lead time. Ready-grown seedlings are listed at the start of the field-readiness window; buy them only when the bed and seedlings are ready. Living corms, slips, cloves and seed potatoes are listed close to planting. For a tray crop, choose either packet seed for the nursery or ready-grown seedlings - not both.
rows.zu: Thola imbewu yokuhlwanyela ngqo noma eyamathreyi ngaphambi kwenyanga yokuhlwanyela eshiwo; umthombo awunikezi isikhathi esisodwa sokuthola imbewu kusengaphambili esisebenza kukho konke. Izithombo esezikhulisiwe zibhalwe ekuqaleni kwesikhathi sokulungela insimu; zithenge kuphela lapho umbhede nezithombo sekulungile. Ama-corm, amahlumela okusika, ama-clove namazambane embewu aphilayo kubhalwe eduze kwesikhathi sokutshala. Uma kuqalwa ethreyini, khetha imbewu yephakethe yendawo yezithombo noma izithombo esezikhulisiwe - hhayi kokubili.
rows.st: Fumana peo ya ho jala ka kotloloho kapa ka diterei pele ho kgwedi ya ho jala e boletsweng; mohlodi ha o fane ka nako e le nngwe ya ho reka pele e sebetsang ho tsohle. Dimela tse nyane tse seng di hodisitswe di thathamisitswe qalong ya nako ya ho lokelwa ke tshimo; di reke feela ha bethe le dimela di se di loketse. Dikutu tse ruruhileng, mahlomela, dikarolwana tsa konofolo le ditapole tsa peo tse phelang di thathamisitswe haufi le nako ya ho lema. Bakeng sa sejalo sa tereing, kgetha peo ya pakete bakeng sa sebaka sa ho hodisa dimela kapa dimela tse seng di hodisitswe - eseng ka bobedi.
rows.ts: Kuma mbewu yo byala hi ku kongoma kumbe ya tireyi ku nga si fika n'hweti yo byala leyi boxiweke; xihlovo a xi nyiki nkarhi wun'we wa ku xava ka ha ri na nkarhi lowu tirhaka eka swibyariwa hinkwaswo. Swimilana leswi se swi kurisiweke swi xaxametiwile eku sunguleni ka nkarhi lowu swi nga lulamelaka nsimu; swi xave ntsena loko mubedo ni swimilana swi lulamile. Swikondo leswi rhurhumukeke swa le hansi ka misava, swirhabyana, swiphemu swa garlic ni mazambhala ya mbewu leswi hanyaka swi xaxametiwile kusuhi ni nkarhi wo byala. Eka xibyariwa xa tireyi, hlawula mbewu ya phakete ya ndhawu yo kurisa swimilana kumbe swimilana leswi se swi kurisiweke - ku nga ri havumbirhi.
rows.ve: Wanani mbeu ya u zwala nga ho livhaho kana ya thireyi phanḓa ha ṅwedzi wa u zwala wo bulwaho; tshiko a tshi ṋei tshifhinga tshithihi tsha u renga hu tshee na tshifhinga tshine tsha shuma kha zwiliṅwa zwoṱhe. Zwimelana zwo no alusiwaho zwo ṅwalwa mathomoni a tshifhinga tsha u lugela tsimu; zwi rengeni fhedzi musi mubete na zwimelana zwo lugela. Zwikondo zwo zwimbaho zwa fhasi ha mavu, matavhi, zwipiḓa zwa garlic na maḓabula a mbeu zwi tshilaho zwo ṅwalwa tsini na u ṱavha. Kha tshiliṅwa tsha thireyi, nangani mbeu ya phakhethe ya fhethu ha zwimelana kana zwimelana zwo no alusiwaho - hu si zwoṱhe zwivhili.

rows.english: A published field seed rate gives a weight range for the mapped area. Confirm the sowing method with the supplier; no germination or loss allowance is added. For crops without a published seed rate, field spacing supports only an approximate FINAL stand. It does not prove a seed-buying quantity: use the packet's crop-specific sowing rate and germination guidance. Living-material ranges are approximate field positions from mapped area and published spacing, not guaranteed order quantities or loss allowances; supplier and crop-specific guidance may change what to purchase.
rows.zu: Isilinganiso sembewu yasensimini esishicilelwe sinikeza ibanga lesisindo lendawo esebalazweni. Qinisekisa indlela yokuhlwanyela nomthengisi; akufakwanga umkhawulo wokubhekelela ukuhluma noma ukulahleka. Ezitshalweni ezingenaso isilinganiso sembewu esishicilelwe, izikhala zasensimini zisekela kuphela isilinganiso sezitshalo ZOKUGCINA. Azifakazeli ubuningi bembewu okufanele ithengwe: sebenzisa isilinganiso sokuhlwanyela nesiqondiso sokuhluma esiqondene nalesi sitshalo esisephaketheni. Amabanga ezinto eziphilayo ayizindawo ezilinganiselwe zasensimini ezisuselwa endaweni esebalazweni nasezikhaleni ezishicilelwe, hhayi ama-oda aqinisekisiwe noma imikhawulo yokulahleka; iseluleko somthengisi nesiqondene nesitshalo singashintsha okufanele kuthengwe.
rows.st: Tekanyo ya peo ya tshimong e phatlaladitsweng e fana ka sebaka sa boima bakeng sa sebaka se mmapeng. Netefatsa mokgwa wa ho jala le mofani; ha ho keketso ya ho dumella ho mela kapa tahlehelo e kentsweng. Bakeng sa dijalo tse se nang tekanyo ya peo e phatlaladitsweng, dikgeo tsa tshimong di tshehetsa feela palo e hakanyeditsweng ya dimela tsa HO QETELA. Ha di netefatse bongata ba peo e lokelang ho rekwa: sebedisa tekanyo ya ho jala le tataiso ya ho mela e tobileng sejalo e paketeng. Bongata bo pakeng tsa meedi ba thepa e phelang ke maemo a hakanyeditsweng a tshimong a tswang sebakeng se mmapeng le dikgeong tse phatlaladitsweng, ha se bongata ba odara bo netefaditsweng kapa dikeketso tsa tahlehelo; keletso ya mofani le e tobileng sejalo e ka fetola se lokelang ho rekwa.
rows.ts: Mpimo wa mbewu ya nsimu lowu kandziyisiweke wu nyika mpimo wa ntiko wa ndhawu leyi nga emepeni. Tiyisisa ndlela yo byala ni muphakeri; a ku engeteriwanga mpimo wa ku mila kumbe wa ku lahlekeriwa. Eka swibyariwa leswi nga riki na mpimo wa mbewu lowu kandziyisiweke, mipfhuka ya nsimu yi seketela ntsena nhlayo leyi ringanyetiweke ya swimila swa le MAKUMU. A yi tiyisisi nhlayo ya mbewu yo xava: tirhisa mpimo wo byala ni swiletelo swa ku mila leswi kongomaka xibyariwa leswi nga eka phakete. Mipimo ya swilo leswi hanyaka i tindhawu ta nsimu leti ringanyetiweke hi ndhawu ya mepe ni mipfhuka leyi kandziyisiweke, a hi nhlayo ya oda leyi tiyisisiweke kumbe mipimo yo pfumelela ku lahlekeriwa; switsundzuxo swa muphakeri ni swa xibyariwa swi nga cinca leswi faneleke ku xaviwa.
rows.ve: Tshikalo tsha mbeu ya tsimuni tsho ganḓiswaho tshi ṋea vhukati ha tshileme kha tshikhala tshi re kha mapa. Khwaṱhisedzani maitele a u zwala na murengisi; a hu na nyengedzo ya u mela kana ya u xelelwa yo engedzwaho. Kha zwiliṅwa zwi si na tshikalo tsha mbeu tsho ganḓiswaho, vhukati ha zwimela tsimuni vhu tikedza fhedzi tshivhalo tsho anganywaho tsha zwimela zwa MAFHELELONI. A zwi khwaṱhisedzi vhunzhi ha mbeu ya u renga: shumisani tshikalo tsha u zwala na ngeletshedzo ya u mela ya tshiliṅwa zwi re kha phakhethe. Mipimo ya zwishumiswa zwi tshilaho ndi fhethu ha tsimuni ho anganywaho nga tshikhala tshi re kha mapa na vhukati ha zwimela ho ganḓiswaho, hu si oda dzo khwaṱhisedzwaho kana nyengedzo dza u xelelwa; ngeletshedzo ya murengisi na ya tshiliṅwa i nga shandula zwine zwa tea u rengwa.

rows.zu: Umndeni we-Cucurbitaceae, ofana no-pumpkin, butternut, cucumber kanye no-watermelon — gwema ukuphinda lo mndeni embhedeni ofanayo. Yisitshalo esinabayo esizwela isithwathwa; alitholakalanga ikhalenda lokuhlwanyela lase-Western Cape nakuba kuyisitshalo esaziwayo e-WC, ngakho kubheke njengento okufanele iqinisekiswe endaweni.
rows.st: Lelapa la Cucurbitaceae, jwaloka pumpkin, butternut, cucumber le watermelon — qoba ho pheta lelapa lena betheng e le nngwe. Ke sejalo se namang se tshabang serame; ha ho khalendara ya ho jala ya Western Cape e fumanweng le hoja e le sejalo se tsejwang sa WC, kahoo se nke e le ntho e hlokang netefatso ya lehae.
rows.ts: Ndyangu wa Cucurbitaceae, ku fana na pumpkin, butternut, cucumber na watermelon — papalata ku phindha ndyangu lowu eka mubedo wun'we. I xibyariwa lexi navaka lexi nga tiyiseliki gwitsi; a ku kumekanga khalendara yo byala ya Western Cape hambiloko xi ri xibyariwa lexi tivekaka xa WC, kutani xi teke xi ri lexi faneleke ku tiyisisiwa endhawini.
rows.ve: Muṱa wa Cucurbitaceae, u fana na pumpkin, butternut, cucumber na watermelon — iledzani u dovha muṱa uyu kha mubete muthihi. Ndi tshiliṅwa tshi kokovhaho tshi sa konḓeleli murotholo; a hu ngo wanala khaḽenda ya u zwala ya Western Cape naho tshi tshiliṅwa tshi ḓivheaho tsha WC, zwenezwo tshi dzhieni sa tshi ṱoḓaho khwaṱhisedzo ya henefho.

rows.english: A biennial herb grown as an annual for its leaves. Apiaceae family, same as carrots — avoid repeating that family in the same bed too often.
rows.zu: Yikhambi eliphila iminyaka emibili kodwa elitshalwa unyaka owodwa ngenxa yamaqabunga alo. Umndeni we-Apiaceae, ofana no-carrots — gwema ukuphinda lo mndeni embhedeni ofanayo kaningi kakhulu.
rows.st: Ke setlama se phelang dilemo tse pedi empa se lengwa selemo se le seng bakeng sa makgasi a sona. Lelapa la Apiaceae, jwaloka carrots — qoba ho pheta lelapa leo betheng e le nngwe kgafetsa haholo.
rows.ts: I ximilana xa nun'hwelo xa malembembirhi lexi byariwaka lembe rin'we ntsena leswaku ku tirhisiwa matluka ya xona. Ndyangu wa Apiaceae, ku fana na carrots — papalata ku phindha ndyangu wolowo eka mubedo wun'we nkarhi ni nkarhi.
rows.ve: Ndi tshimela tsha nun'hwelo tshi tshilaho miṅwaha mivhili fhedzi tshi ṱavhelwaho ṅwaha muthihi u wana maṱari atsho. Muṱa wa Apiaceae, u fana na carrots — iledzani u dovha muṱa wonoyo kha mubete muthihi lunzhi nga maanḓa.

rows.english: A drought-tolerant grain crop, more heat- and dry-tolerant than maize. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting May harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here. No named SA cultivars were found.
rows.zu: Yisitshalo sokusanhlamvu esibekezelela isomiso, esibekezelela ukushisa nokoma ngaphezu kwe-maize. Ukuhlwanyela ngo-Disemba akufakwanga kumhleli wale khathalogi ngoba isivuno esilandelayo sango-Meyi singahlangana nesithwathwa — kusengenzeka ngokuvikelwa endaweni esithwathweni, kodwa akuhlelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo lapha. Azitholakalanga izinhlobo ze-cultivar zase-SA ezibizwe ngamagama.
rows.st: Ke sejalo sa mabele se mamellang komello, se mamellang mocheso le komello ho feta maize. Ho jala ka Tshitwe ho siilwe moralong wa khathaloko ena hobane kotulo e tlang ka Motsheanong e ka kopana le serame — ho ntse ho ka etswa ka tshireletso ya lehae kgahlanong le serame, empa ha ho hlophiswe ka boiketsetso mona. Ha ho di-cultivar tsa SA tse bitsitsweng ka mabitso tse fumanweng.
rows.ts: I xibyariwa xa mavele lexi tiyiselaka dyandza, lexi tiyiselaka ku hisa ni ku oma ku hundza maize. Ku byala hi N'wendzamhala a ku katsiwanga eka muhleri wa khathaloko leyi hikuva ntshovelo lowu landzelaka hi Mudyaxihi wu nga hlangana ni gwitsi — swa ha koteka hi ku sirhelela eka gwitsi endhawini, ntsena a swi hleriwi hi ku tirha hi swoxe laha. A ku kumekanga ti-cultivar ta SA leti boxiweke hi mavito.
rows.ve: Ndi tshiliṅwa tsha thoro tshi konḓelelaho gomelelo, tshi konḓelelaho mufhiso na u oma u fhira maize. U zwala nga Nyendavhusiku a ho ngo katelwa kha mupulani wa khathalogo iyi ngauri khaṋo i tevhelaho nga Shundunthule i nga ṱangana na murotholo — zwi kha ḓi konadzea nga tsireledzo ya murotholo ya henefho, fhedzi a zwi dzudzanyiwi nga zwone zwiṋe fhano. A hu ngo wanala dzi-cultivar dza SA dzo bulwaho nga madzina.

rows.english: A fast-cropping Cucurbitaceae vine picked young and often — same rotation family as pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber and watermelon. Frost-tender; no Western Cape calendar sourced.
rows.zu: Yisitshalo esinabayo se-Cucurbitaceae esivunwa ngokushesha, sisencane futhi kaningi — umndeni ofanayo wokushintshanisa izitshalo no-pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber kanye no-watermelon. Sizwela isithwathwa; alitholakalanga ikhalenda elinomthombo lase-Western Cape.
rows.st: Ke sejalo se namang sa Cucurbitaceae se kotulwang kapele, se sa le senyane le kgafetsa — lelapa le le leng la phapanyetsano ya dijalo le pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber le watermelon. Se tshaba serame; ha ho khalendara ya Western Cape e nang le mohlodi e fumanweng.
rows.ts: I xibyariwa lexi navaka xa Cucurbitaceae lexi tshoveriwaka hi ku hatlisa, xa ha ri xitsongo ni nkarhi ni nkarhi — ndyangu wun'we wa ku cincana ka swibyariwa ni pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber na watermelon. A xi tiyiseli gwitsi; a ku kumekanga khalendara ya Western Cape leyi nga ni xihlovo.
rows.ve: Ndi tshiliṅwa tshi kokovhaho tsha Cucurbitaceae tshi kaṋiwaho nga u ṱavhanya, tshi tshee tshiṱuku nahone lunzhi — muṱa muthihi wa u tshintshana ha zwiliṅwa na pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber na watermelon. A tshi konḓeleli murotholo; a hu ngo wanala khaḽenda ya Western Cape i re na tshiko.

rows.english: Cucurbitaceae melon vine. A January sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here.
rows.zu: Yisitshalo se-melon esinabayo somndeni we-Cucurbitaceae. Ukuhlwanyela ngo-Januwari akufakwanga kumhleli wale khathalogi ngoba isivuno esilandelayo singahlangana nesithwathwa — kusengenzeka ngokuvikelwa endaweni esithwathweni, kodwa akuhlelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo lapha.
rows.st: Ke sejalo se namang sa melon sa lelapa la Cucurbitaceae. Ho jala ka Pherekgong ho siilwe moralong wa khathaloko ena hobane kotulo e tlang e ka kopana le serame — ho ntse ho ka etswa ka tshireletso ya lehae kgahlanong le serame, empa ha ho hlophiswe ka boiketsetso mona.
rows.ts: I xibyariwa lexi navaka xa melon xa ndyangu wa Cucurbitaceae. Ku byala hi Sunguti a ku katsiwanga eka muhleri wa khathaloko leyi hikuva ntshovelo lowu landzelaka wu nga hlangana ni gwitsi — swa ha koteka hi ku sirhelela eka gwitsi endhawini, ntsena a swi hleriwi hi ku tirha hi swoxe laha.
rows.ve: Ndi tshiliṅwa tshi kokovhaho tsha melon tsha muṱa wa Cucurbitaceae. U zwala nga Phando a ho ngo katelwa kha mupulani wa khathalogo iyi ngauri khaṋo i tevhelaho i nga ṱangana na murotholo — zwi kha ḓi konadzea nga tsireledzo ya murotholo ya henefho, fhedzi a zwi dzudzanyiwi nga zwone zwiṋe fhano.

rows.english: Grown and eaten as a fresh vegetable, unlike field maize — the dossier's own food-group is fruiting vegetable, not staple grain, so it is kept there rather than lumped with maize despite the shared species. Tender to frost like maize.
rows.zu: Itshalwa futhi idliwe njengemifino emisha, ngokungafani ne-maize yasensimini — iqembu lokudla elisembikweni womthombo uqobo liyimifino ethelayo, hhayi okusanhlamvu kokudla okuyisisekelo, ngakho igcinwa kulelo qembu kunokuba ihlanganiswe ne-maize nakuba kuwuhlobo lwe-species olufanayo. Izwela isithwathwa njenge-maize.
rows.st: E lengwa le ho jewa e le meroho e foreshe, ho fapana le maize wa tshimong — sehlopha sa dijo sa tlaleho ya mohlodi ka boyona ke meroho e behang ditholwana, eseng mabele a motheo, kahoo e dula moo ho e na le ho kopanngwa le maize leha e le species e le nngwe. E tshaba serame jwaloka maize.
rows.ts: Xi byariwa ni ku dyiwa xi ri matsavu lamantshwa, ku hambana ni maize wa nsimu — ntlawa wa swakudya wa dosiye hi yoxe i matsavu lama humesaka mihandzu, a hi mavele ya swakudya swa nkoka, kutani xi hlayisiwa kwalaho ematshan'weni yo xi hlanganisa na maize hambiloko swi ri species yin'we. A xi tiyiseli gwitsi ku fana na maize.
rows.ve: Tshi ṱavhiwa na u ḽiwa sa miroho miswa, u fhambana na maize ya tsimuni — tshigwada tsha zwiḽiwa tsha dosiye nga tshayo ndi miroho i aṋwaho, hu si thoro dza zwiḽiwa zwa mutheo, zwenezwo tshi vhewa henefho nṱhani ha u ṱanganywa na maize naho zwi species nthihi. A tshi konḓeleli murotholo u fana na maize.

rows.english: A dual-purpose legume: young leaves (imifino) can be picked from three to four weeks after sowing, and dry grain follows later. No yield figure is given because the only South African trial found disagreed twenty-fold between its two sites. No named SA cultivars were found.
rows.zu: Yisitshalo sohlobo lwemidumba esisetshenziswa ngezindlela ezimbili: amaqabunga asemancane (imifino) angakhiwa kusukela emasontweni angu-3 kuya ku-4 ngemva kokuhlwanyela, bese okusanhlamvu okomile kulandela kamuva. Akunikezwa inani lesivuno ngoba ukuhlola okuwukuphela kwakho kwaseNingizimu Afrika okwatholakala kwaba nemiphumela ehluke izikhathi ezingu-20 phakathi kwezindawo zako ezingu-2. Azitholakalanga izinhlobo ze-cultivar zase-SA ezibizwe ngamagama.
rows.st: Ke sejalo sa lelapa la dinawa se nang le mesebetsi e mmedi: makgasi a manyane (imifino) a ka kgwa ho tloha dibekeng tse 3 ho isa ho tse 4 kamora ho jala, mme mabele a omileng a latela hamorao. Ha ho palo ya kotulo e fanweng hobane teko e le nngwe feela ya Afrika Borwa e fumanweng e ne e na le diphetho tse fapaneng makgetlo a 20 pakeng tsa dibaka tsa yona tse 2. Ha ho di-cultivar tsa SA tse bitsitsweng ka mabitso tse fumanweng.
rows.ts: I xibyariwa xa ndyangu wa tinyawa lexi nga ni mitirho mimbirhi: matluka lamatsongo (imifino) ma nga khiwa ku sukela eka mavhiki ya 3 ku fika eka 4 endzhaku ko byala, kutani mavele yo oma ma landzela endzhaku. A ku nyikiwi nhlayo ya ntshovelo hikuva ndzavisiso wa Afrika-Dzonga wun'we ntsena lowu kumiweke wu ve ni mivuyelo leyi hambaneke hi ku andzisiwa ka 20 eka tindhawu ta wona ta 2. A ku kumekanga ti-cultivar ta SA leti boxiweke hi mavito.
rows.ve: Ndi tshiliṅwa tsha muṱa wa ṋawa tshi re na mishumo mivhili: maṱari maṱuku (imifino) a nga kaṋiwa u bva kha vhege dza 3 u swika kha 4 nga murahu ha u zwala, thoro dzo oma dza tevhela nga murahu. A hu ṋeiwi tshivhalo tsha khaṋo ngauri ndingo nthihi fhedzi ya Afurika Tshipembe yo wanalaho yo vha na mvelelo dzo fhambanaho nga u andisa nga 20 vhukati ha fhethu hayo ha 2. A hu ngo wanala dzi-cultivar dza SA dzo bulwaho nga madzina.

rows.english: A very fast root crop, ready in three to four weeks — good for filling gaps between slower crops. No published yield figure was found, so it stays manual and will not drive auto-suggest ranking. Brassicaceae family, same as cabbage and turnip.
rows.zu: Yisitshalo sezimpande esishesha kakhulu, esilunga emasontweni angu-3 kuya ku-4 — silungele ukugcwalisa izikhala phakathi kwezitshalo ezihamba kancane. Akutholakalanga inani lesivuno elishicilelwe, ngakho sihlala sikhethwa ngesandla futhi ngeke sisetshenziselwe ukuhlelwa kwezinhlelo eziphakanyiswa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Umndeni we-Brassicaceae, ofana no-cabbage no-turnip.
rows.st: Ke sejalo sa metso se potlakang haholo, se loketseng ka dibeke tse 3 ho isa ho tse 4 — se loketse ho tlatsa dikgeo pakeng tsa dijalo tse diehang. Ha ho palo ya kotulo e phatlaladitsweng e fumanweng, kahoo se dula se kgethwa ka letsoho mme se ke ke sa laola tatellano ya ditlhahiso tsa boiketsetso. Lelapa la Brassicaceae, jwaloka cabbage le turnip.
rows.ts: I xibyariwa xa timitsu lexi hatlisaka ngopfu, lexi lulamaka hi mavhiki ya 3 ku fika eka 4 — xi kahle eka ku tata swivandla leswi nga phakathi ka swibyariwa leswi hlwelaka. A ku kumekanga nhlayo ya ntshovelo leyi kandziyisiweke, kutani xi tshamaka xi hlawuriwa hi voko naswona a xi nge lawuli ku hleriwa ka swibumabumelo swa ku tirha hi swoxe. Ndyangu wa Brassicaceae, ku fana na cabbage na turnip.
rows.ve: Ndi tshiliṅwa tsha midzi tshi ṱavhanyaho vhukuma, tshi lugelaho kha vhege dza 3 u swika kha 4 — tsho tea u ḓadza zwikhala vhukati ha zwiliṅwa zwi lengaho. A hu ngo wanala tshivhalo tsha khaṋo tsho ganḓiswaho, zwenezwo tshi dzula tshi tshi nangwa nga tshanḓa nahone a tshi nga langi mutevhe wa themendelo dza u ḓiitela. Muṱa wa Brassicaceae, u fana na cabbage na turnip.

rows.english: Write the food and its source: tree, coop, hive or bed. Use kg for weighed food, eggs for counted eggs, or jars, bunches or items. Record jar size in the source column. Keep all amounts on one row in the same unit.
rows.zu: Bhala ukudla nomthombo wakho: isihlahla, ihhoko lezinkukhu, isidleke sezinyosi noma umbhede. Sebenzisa i-kg uma ukudla kukaliwe ngesisindo, amaqanda uma kubalwe amaqanda, noma izimbiza, izixha noma izinto. Bhala usayizi wembiza kukholomu yomthombo. Gcina wonke amanani asemgqeni owodwa ekuyunithi efanayo.
rows.st: Ngola dijo le mohlodi wa tsona: sefate, hoko ya dikgoho, motshitshi wa dinotshi kapa bethe. Sebedisa kg bakeng sa dijo tse lekantsweng ka boima, mahe bakeng sa mahe a balilweng, kapa dinkgo, dingata kapa dintho. Rekota boholo ba nkgo kholomong ya mohlodi. Boloka bongata bohle moleng o le mong ka yuniti e tshwanang.
rows.ts: Tsala swakudya ni xihlovo xa swona: murhi, yindlu ya tihuku, xihahlu xa tinyoxi kumbe mubedo. Tirhisa kg eka swakudya leswi pimiweke hi ntiko, matandza eka matandza lama hlayiweke, kumbe tijara, tinyandza kumbe swilo. Rhekhoda sayizi ya jara eka kholomo ya xihlovo. Tirhisa yuniti yin’we eka nhlayo yin’wana ni yin’wana leyi nga eka ntila wun’we.
rows.ve: Ṅwalani zwiḽiwa na tshiko tshazwo: muri, hoko ya khuhu, ḓulu ḽa ṋotshi kana mubete. Shumisani kg kha zwiḽiwa zwo kalwaho nga tshileme, makumba kha makumba o vhaliwaho, kana dzidzhege, zwivhofho kana zwithu. Rekhodani saizi ya dzhege kha khoḽomu ya tshiko. Vheani zwivhalo zwoṱhe zwi re kha mutalo muthihi kha yuniti nthihi.

rows.english: A crop plan should reduce uncertainty. It should show the garden team what to prepare, plant, harvest and buy - without making them decode the system behind it.
rows.zu: Uhlelo lwezitshalo kufanele lunciphise ukungaqiniseki. Kufanele lubonise ithimba lengadi ukuthi yini okufanele liyilungiselele, liyitshale, liyivune futhi liyithenge - ngaphandle kokuba lichaze uhlelo olusemuva kwakho.
rows.st: Moralo wa dijalo o lokela ho fokotsa ho se tiisehe. O lokela ho bontsha sehlopha sa tshimo seo se lokelang ho se lokisa, ho se lema, ho se kotula le ho se reka - ntle le hore se qale ka ho manolla tsamaiso e ka mora ona.
rows.ts: Pulani ya swibyariwa yi fanele ku hunguta ku nga tiyiseki. Yi fanele ku komba ntlawa wa nsimu leswi faneleke ku lulamisiwa, ku byariwa, ku tshoveriwa ni ku xaviwa - ku nga laveki leswaku wu rhanga hi ku twisisa sisiteme leyi nga endzhaku ka yona.
rows.ve: Pulane ya zwiliṅwa i tea u fhungudza u sa vha na vhuṱanzi. I tea u sumbedza tshigwada tsha tsimu zwine tsha tea u lugisa, u ṱavha, u kaṋa na u renga - zwi sa ṱoḓi uri tshi thome nga u ṱalutshedza sisiteme i re murahu hayo.

rows.ve: Notsi ya tshati: tshati ya mishumo i vhalela mishumo yo dzudzanywaho, hu si awara - tsimu ya maize na mubete wa lettuce zwiṅwe na zwiṅwe zwi vhalwa sa mushumo muthihi. Zwileme zwa zwikalo zwa mutevhe ya zwiliṅwa zwi sumbedzwa nga tshiliṅwa fhedzi; a hu anganyelwi kg kana Rand dza ṅwedzi.

rows.english: Outlined bands are planning references when established; they do not enter food totals or picking jobs. Blank months have no picking window marked. Recorded planting ages keep young plants out of early reference months. Check plant ages and Food sources to check in the app. Gold rows require each crop’s storage conditions; check the full plan or app. Red space figures mean the plan needs more growing space than is mapped.
rows.zu: Imigqa yohlaka iyizinkomba zokuhlela lapho izitshalo sezimile kahle; ayifakwa esambeni sokudla noma emisebenzini yokuvuna. Izinyanga ezingenalutho azinazo izikhathi zokuvuna ezimakiwe. Ubudala bezitshalo oburekhodiwe bugcina izitshalo ezincane zingafakwa ezinyangeni zokuqala zezinkomba. Hlola ubudala bezitshalo neMithombo yokudla edinga ukuhlolwa ohlelweni. Imigqa yegolide idinga imibandela yokugcina yesitshalo ngasinye; hlola uhlelo oluphelele noma i-app. Izibalo zendawo ezibomvu zisho ukuthi uhlelo ludinga indawo yokutshala engaphezu kweyasebalazweni.
rows.st: Dibanta tsa mola wa kantle ke mehlodi ya moralo ha dimela di se di tsitsitse; ha di kenngwe dikakaretsong tsa dijo kapa mesebetsing ya kotulo. Dikgwedi tse se nang letho ha di na nako ya kotulo e tshwailweng. Dilemo tsa ho lema tse rekotilweng di thibela dimela tse nyane ho kenngwa dikgweding tsa pele tsa mehlodi. Hlahloba dilemo tsa dimela le Mehlodi ya dijo e hlokang ho hlahlojwa ho app. Mela ya kgauta e hloka maemo a poloko a sejalo ka seng; hlahloba moralo o felletseng kapa app. Dipalo tse kgubedu tsa sebaka di bolela hore moralo o hloka sebaka sa temo se fetang se mmapeng.
rows.ts: Tibendi ta rimba i swikombo swo kunguhata loko swimila swi mile swi tiya; a swi katsiwi eka tinhlayo ta swakudya kumbe mintirho yo tshovela. Tin’hweti leti nga riki na swilo a ti na nkarhi wo tshovela lowu funghiweke. Vukhale bya swimila lowu rhekhodiweke byi sivela swimila leswitsongo ku katsiwa eka tin’hweti ta le ku sunguleni ta swikombo. Kambela vukhale bya swimila ni Swihlovo swa swakudya leswi faneleke ku kamberiwa eka app. Mintila ya nsuku yi lava swiyimo swa vuhlayiselo swa xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana; kambela pulani leyi heleleke kumbe app. Tinhlayo to tshwuka ta ndhawu ti vula leswaku pulani yi lava ndhawu yo byala yo tala ku hundza leyi nga eka mepe.
rows.ve: Mabande a luhura ndi zwiko zwa u pulana musi zwimela zwo no khwaṱha; a zwi katelwi kha tshivhalo tsha zwiḽiwa kana mishumo ya u kaṋa. Miṅwedzi i si na tshithu a i na tshifhinga tsha u kaṋa tsho swaiwaho. Miṅwaha ya zwimela yo rekhodiwaho i thivhela zwimela zwiṱuku u katelwa kha miṅwedzi ya u thoma ya zwiko. Sedzulusani miṅwaha ya zwimela na Zwiko zwa zwiḽiwa zwine zwa fanela u sedzuluswa kha app. Mitalo ya musuku i ṱoḓa nyimele dza u vhulunga dza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe; sedzulusani pulane yo fhelelaho kana app. Mbalo tswuku dza fhethu dzi amba uri pulane i ṱoḓa fhethu ha u lima hunzhi u fhira hu re kha mapa.

rows.english: Shelled grain dried to ≤14% moisture, kept in a clean sealed container or silo with active weevil/larger-grain-borer control.
rows.zu: Izinhlamvu ezikhishiwe emakhobeni zomiswe zibe nomswakama ongu-14% noma ngaphansi, zigcinwe esitsheni esihlanzekile esivaliwe noma esilweni, kulawulwa ngokuqhubekayo izimbungulu zezinhlamvu ne-larger-grain-borer.
rows.st: Dithollo tse ntshitsweng di omisitswe ho mongobo wa 14% kapa ka tlase, di bolokilwe setshelong se hlwekileng se kwetsweng kapa saelong, ho ntse ho laolwa dikokwanyana tsa dithollo le larger-grain-borer.
rows.ts: Tindzoho leti susiweke emakaveni ti omisiwile ku fika eka ndzhongho wa 14% kumbe ehansi, ti hlayisiwa eka xibye lexi baseke lexi pfariweke kumbe silo, ku ri ni vulawuri bya swifufunhunu swa tindzoho ni larger-grain-borer.
rows.ve: Thoro dzo bviswaho kha makwati dzo omiswa u swika kha muṋando wa 14% kana fhasi, dzo vhulungwa kha tshifaredzi tsho kunaho tsho valiwaho kana silo, hu tshi khou langulwa zwikhokhonono zwa thoro na larger-grain-borer.

rows.english: Fully dried grain (12-15% moisture), clean sealed containers, cool and dry, with bruchid/weevil control (e.g. edible-oil admix at 5ml/kg, or storage in-pod).
rows.zu: Izinhlamvu ezomiswe ngokuphelele (umswakama ongu-12-15%), izitsha ezihlanzekile ezivaliwe, endaweni epholile neyomile, kulawulwa izimbungulu ze-bruchid/weevil (isibonelo ukuxuba amafutha adliwayo ngo-5ml/kg, noma ukugcina zisemakhobeni).
rows.st: Dithollo tse omisitsweng ka botlalo (mongobo wa 12-15%), ditshelo tse hlwekileng tse kwetsweng, sebakeng se phodileng se ommeng, ka taolo ya bruchid/weevil (mohlala ho tswaka oli e jewang ka 5ml/kg, kapa ho boloka di le ka hara makgapetla).
rows.ts: Tindzoho leti omisiweke hi ku helela (ndzhongho wa 12-15%), swibye leswi baseke leswi pfariweke, laha ku titimelaka ni ku oma, ku ri ni vulawuri bya bruchid/weevil (xikombiso ku hlanganisa mafurha lama dyiwaka hi 5ml/kg, kumbe ku hlayisa ti ri emarhambyini ya tona).
rows.ve: Thoro dzo omiswaho tshoṱhe (muṋando wa 12-15%), zwifaredzi zwo kunaho zwo valiwaho, fhethu hu rotholelaho ho omaho, hu na ndangulo ya bruchid/weevil (sa tsumbo u ṱanganyisa mapfura a u ḽa nga 5ml/kg, kana u vhulunga dzi kha makwati).

rows.english: Mature hard-rind fruit, cured, clean, dry, undamaged, kept ventilated at 10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.zu: Izithelo ezivuthiwe ezinesikhumba esiqinile, ezelashwe ngokomiswa, ezihlanzekile, ezomile, ezingalimele, zigcinwe endaweni engenisa umoya ngo-10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.st: Ditholwana tse butswitseng tse nang le lekgapetla le thata, tse omisitsweng ho tiisa lekgapetla, tse hlwekileng, tse ommeng, tse sa senyehang, di bolokilwe moo ho kenang moya ka 10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.ts: Mihandzu leyi wupfeke leyi nga ni nhlonge yo tiya, leyi omisiweke ku tiyisa nhlonge, leyi baseke, leyi omeke, leyi nga onhakangiki, yi hlayisiwa laha ku nghenaka moya eka 10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.ve: Mitshelo yo vhibvaho i re na lukanda lwo khwaṱhaho, yo omiswa u khwaṱhisa lukanda, yo kunaho, yo omaho, i songo tshinyadzwaho, yo vhulungwa fhethu hu no dzhenwa nga muya kha 10-15°C/50-70% RH.

rows.english: Mature, cured (hardened-skin) fruit, undamaged, kept ventilated at 10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.zu: Izithelo ezivuthiwe, ezelashwe ngokomiswa (isikhumba esiqinisiwe), ezingalimele, zigcinwe endaweni engenisa umoya ngo-10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.st: Ditholwana tse butswitseng, tse omisitsweng ho tiisa lekgapetla, tse sa senyehang, di bolokilwe moo ho kenang moya ka 10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.ts: Mihandzu leyi wupfeke, leyi omisiweke ku tiyisa nhlonge, leyi nga onhakangiki, yi hlayisiwa laha ku nghenaka moya eka 10-15°C/50-70% RH.
rows.ve: Mitshelo yo vhibvaho, yo omiswa u khwaṱhisa lukanda, i songo tshinyadzwaho, yo vhulungwa fhethu hu no dzhenwa nga muya kha 10-15°C/50-70% RH.

rows.english: Field-dried (cured, necks fully dry) bulbs held at ambient temperature in well-ventilated trays/racks.
rows.zu: Ama-bulb omiswe ensimini (elashwe ngokomiswa, izintamo zome ngokuphelele), agcinwe ezingeni lokushisa lendawo emathreyini/emarakhini angenisa umoya kahle.
rows.st: Ditleloubu tse omisitsweng tshimong (ho tiisa letlalo, melala e omme ka botlalo), di bolokilwe motjhesong wa sebaka ditereing/dirakeng tse nang le moya o kenang hantle.
rows.ts: Tibulb leti omisiweke ensinwini (ku tiyisa nhlonge, tinhana ti omile hi ku helela), ti hlayisiwa eka mahiselo ya ndhawu etithireyini/etirakeni leti nghenaka moya kahle.
rows.ve: Mabulu o omiswaho tsimuni (u khwaṱhisa lukanda, mitsinga yo oma tshoṱhe), o vhulungwa kha mufhiso wa fhethu kha thireyi/raka dzine dza dzhenwa nga muya zwavhuḓi.

rows.english: Only mature, undamaged roots; cured 30-32°C/85-90% RH for 4-7 days, then stored with minimal handling as cool as achievable (source optimum 13°C) at ~85-90% RH. The sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) is the main storage threat.
rows.zu: Izimpande ezivuthiwe nezingalimele kuphela; zelashwe ngo-30-32°C/85-90% RH izinsuku ezingu-4-7, bese zigcinwa zingaphathwa kakhulu, endaweni ephole kakhulu ngangokunokwenzeka (umthombo uthi okungcono kungu-13°C) ku-~85-90% RH. I-sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) iyingozi enkulu yokugcina.
rows.st: Ke metso e butswitseng e sa senyehang feela; e phekotswe ka 30-32°C/85-90% RH matsatsi a 4-7, ebe e bolokwa e tshwarwa hanyenyane kamoo ho ka kgonehang, sebakeng se phodileng ka ho fetisisa se ka fumanehang (mohlodi o re se loketseng ke 13°C) ka ~85-90% RH. Sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) ke kotsi e kgolo polokong.
rows.ts: Ku va timitsu leti wupfeke leti nga onhakangiki ntsena; ti tshunguriwa eka 30-32°C/85-90% RH masiku ya 4-7, kutani ti hlayisiwa ti khomiwa katsongo swinene, laha ku titimelaka swinene ku ya hi leswi kotekaka (xihlovo xi vula leswaku ku antswa eka 13°C) eka ~85-90% RH. Sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) i khombo lerikulu ra vuhlayiselo.
rows.ve: Midzi yo vhibvaho i songo tshinyadzwaho fhedzi; i lafhiwa kha 30-32°C/85-90% RH lwa maḓuvha a 4-7, ya kona i vhulungwe i tshi farwa zwiṱuku nga hune zwa konadzea ngaho, fhethu hu rotholelaho vhukuma nga hune zwa konadzea ngaho (tshiko tshi ri hune ha vha khwine ndi 13°C) kha ~85-90% RH. Sweet potato weevil (Cylas spp.) ndi khombo khulwane ya u vhulunga.

rows.english: Cured 15-20°C/85-90% RH for 5-10 days, then kept dark and naturally ventilated averaging ~15°C or cooler, no sprout inhibitor.
rows.zu: Kwelashwe ngo-15-20°C/85-90% RH izinsuku ezingu-5-10, bese kugcinwa ebumnyameni kungene umoya ngokwemvelo ngesilinganiso esingu-~15°C noma ngaphansi, kungasetshenziswa isivimbeli sokuhluma.
rows.st: Di phekotswe ka 15-20°C/85-90% RH matsatsi a 5-10, ebe di bolokwa lefifing moo ho kenang moya ka tlhaho ka karolelano ya ~15°C kapa ka tlase, ho se na sethibela ho mela.
rows.ts: Swi tshunguriwa eka 15-20°C/85-90% RH masiku ya 5-10, kutani swi hlayisiwa emunyameni laha moya wu nghenaka hi ntumbuluko hi avhareji ya ~15°C kumbe ku titimela ku tlurisa, ku nga ri na xitirhisiwa xo sivela ku hluka.
rows.ve: Zwi lafhiwa kha 15-20°C/85-90% RH lwa maḓuvha a 5-10, zwa kona zwi vhulungwe swiswini hu tshi dzhenwa nga muya nga mvelo kha phimo ya ~15°C kana hu rotholelaho u fhira afho, hu si na tshithivheli tsha u mela.

rows.english: Cool, dry, well-ventilated storage at ambient 25-30°C — traditionally heaped corms under shade or covered with straw/plantain leaves.
rows.zu: Kugcinwe endaweni epholile, eyomile, engenisa umoya kahle ezingeni lokushisa lendawo elingu-25-30°C - ngokwesiko kunqwatshelaniswa ama-corm emthunzini noma ambozwe ngotshani/ngamaqabunga e-plantain.
rows.st: Poloko e phodileng, e ommeng, e nang le moya o kenang hantle motjhesong wa sebaka wa 25-30°C - ka setso di-corm di bokellwa moriting kapa di kwahelwa ka jwang/mahlaku a plantain.
rows.ts: Vuhlayiselo byo titimela, byo oma, byo nghena moya kahle eka mahiselo ya ndhawu ya 25-30°C - hi ndhavuko ti-corm ti hlengeletiwa endzhutini kumbe ti funengetiwa hi byanyi/matluka ya plantain.
rows.ve: U vhulunga fhethu hu rotholelaho, ho omaho, hu no dzhenwa nga muya zwavhuḓi kha mufhiso wa fhethu wa 25-30°C - nga mvelele ma-corm a kuvhanganywa murunzini kana a fukedzwa nga hatsi/maṱari a plantain.

rows.english: Unshelled (in-shell) pods dried to in-shell moisture ~10% or less, stored in gunny bags, mud bins, baskets or a ventilated dry room, protected from pests and damp.
rows.zu: Amakhoba angakakhishwa (asamagobolondo) omiswe abe nomswakama ongaba ngu-~10% noma ngaphansi egobolondweni, agcinwe ezikhwameni zegunny, ezitsheni zodaka, kobhasikidi noma egumbini elomile elingenisa umoya, avikelwe ezinambuzaneni nasemswakameni.
rows.st: Makgapetla a sa ntshwa (a ntse a le dikgetleng) a omisitswe ho mongobo wa ka hara kgetla wa ~10% kapa ka tlase, a bolokilwe mekotleng ya gunny, dipolokelong tsa seretse, dibasketeng kapa phaposing e ommeng e kenang moya, a sireleditswe ho dikokwanyana le mongobo.
rows.ts: Marhambi lama nga susiwangiki makamba (ma ha ri emakambeni) ma omisiwile ku fika eka ndzhongho wa le ndzeni ka kamba wa ~10% kumbe ehansi, ma hlayisiwa eminkwameni ya gunny, eswibyeni swa misava, emibasikitini kumbe ekamareni ro oma leri nghenaka moya, ma sirheleriwile eka switsotswana ni ndzhongho.
rows.ve: Makwati a songo bviswaho (a kha ganda) o omiswa u swika kha muṋando wa nga ngomu ha ganda wa ~10% kana fhasi, o vhulungwa kha masaga a gunny, zwifaredzi zwa mavu, manngi kana kamara yo omaho i dzhenwaho nga muya, o tsireledzwa kha zwikhokhonono na muṋando.

rows.english: Well-cured bulbs (dried several weeks, dark/dry/ventilated), then kept unrefrigerated in a cool, dry, dark, well-ventilated place (e.g. mesh bags).
rows.zu: Ama-bulb elashwe kahle ngokomiswa (omiswe amasonto ambalwa, ebumnyameni/omile/angenisa umoya), bese egcinwa ngaphandle kwesiqandisi endaweni epholile, eyomile, emnyama, engenisa umoya kahle (isibonelo ezikhwameni zenetha).
rows.st: Ditleloubu tse omisitsweng hantle ho tiisa letlalo (di omisitswe dibeke tse mmalwa, lefifing/di omme/ho kena moya), ebe di bolokwa ntle le sehatsetsi sebakeng se phodileng, se ommeng, se lefifi, se nang le moya o kenang hantle (mohlala mekotleng ya letlowa).
rows.ts: Tibulb leti omisiweke kahle ku tiyisa nhlonge (ti omisiwile mavhiki yo hlayanyana, emunyameni/ti omile/ku nghena moya), kutani ti hlayisiwa ehandle ka firiji laha ku titimelaka, ku omeke, ku nga ni munyama, ku nghenaka moya kahle (xikombiso eminkwameni ya nete).
rows.ve: Mabulu o omiswaho zwavhuḓi u khwaṱhisa lukanda (o omiswa vhege dzi si gathi, swiswini/o oma/hu dzhenwa nga muya), a kona a vhulungwe hu si kha tshirothodzi fhethu hu rotholelaho, ho omaho, ha swiswi, hu no dzhenwa nga muya zwavhuḓi (sa tsumbo kha masaga a nete).

rows.ve: Tshiko tsha u kaṋa ha u thoma, hu si tshifhinga tshoṱhe tsha khaṋo.

rows.english: Elgin first-pick reference, not the whole harvest duration. No other apple cultivar months are joined to it.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sokuvuna kokuqala sase-Elgin, hhayi sonke isikhathi sesivuno. Azihlanganiswa naso izinyanga zezinye izinhlobo ze-apple.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa kotulo ya pele wa Elgin, eseng nako yohle ya kotulo. Ha ho dikgwedi tsa mefuta e meng ya apple tse kopanngwang le wona.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ku tshovela ko sungula xa Elgin, ku nga ri nkarhi hinkwawo wa ntshovelo. A ku hlanganisiwi tin’hweti ta mixaka yin’wana ya apple eka xona.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha u kaṋa ha u thoma tsha Elgin, hu si tshifhinga tshoṱhe tsha khaṋo. A hu ṱanganyiswi miṅwedzi ya dziṅwe tshaka dza apple kha tshone.

rows.english: Reference first pick; confirm chilling and compatible pollinator.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sokuvuna kokuqala; qinisekisa amakhaza adingekayo nesitshalo esifanele sempova.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa kotulo ya pele; netefatsa serame se hlokahalang le semela se fanang ka peo ya palesa se dumellanang.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ku tshovela ko sungula; tiyisisa xirhami ni ximilana lexi fambisanaka xo nyikela pollen.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha u kaṋa ha u thoma; khwaṱhisedzani phepho na tshimela tshi tshimbidzanaho tsha u ṋea pollen.

rows.english: KZN outdoor reference, not the Transvaal tunnel season.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sangaphandle sase-KZN, hhayi isikhathi semihubhe yase-Transvaal.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa temo ya kantle wa KZN, eseng nako ya ditanele tsa Transvaal.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa le handle xa KZN, ku nga ri nguva ya tithanele ta Transvaal.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha nnḓa tsha KZN, hu si khalaṅwaha ya thaneḽe dza Transvaal.

rows.english: Assumes light frost; check severity locally.
rows.zu: Kucatshangwa isithwathwa esincane; hlola ubukhulu baso endaweni.
rows.st: Ho hakanyetswa serame sa lehlwa se bobebe; hlahloba matla a sona sebakeng.
rows.ts: Ku ringanyetiwa gwitsi ritsongo; kambela ku tika ka rona endhawini.
rows.ve: Hu anganyelwa luvhame luṱuku; sedzulusani vhuhulu halwo henefho.

rows.english: Irrigated production reference; confirm cultivar, pollination, summer heat and water capacity.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sokukhiqiza okuniselwa; qinisekisa uhlobo, impova, ukushisa kwasehlobo namandla amanzi.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa tlhahiso e nosetswang; netefatsa mofuta, ho fetisa peo ya palesa, motjheso wa lehlabula le bokgoni ba metsi.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa vuhumelerisi byo cheletiwa; tiyisisa muxaka, ku rhurhisa pollen, ku hisa ka ximumu ni vuswikoti bya mati.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha mveledzo ya u sheledza; khwaṱhisedzani lushaka, u tshimbidza pollen, mufhiso wa tshilimo na vhukoni ha maḓi.

rows.english: KZN regional reference; cultivar-specific local timing remains unknown.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sesifunda sase-KZN; isikhathi sendawo esiqondene nohlobo sisengaziwa.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sebaka wa KZN; nako ya sebaka e tobileng mofuta o itseng e ntse e sa tsejwe.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa xifundzha xa KZN; nkarhi wa ndhawu wa muxaka wo karhi wa ha nga tiveki.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha dzingu tsha KZN; tshifhinga tsha henefho tsha lushaka lwo khetheaho a tshi athu ḓivhea.

rows.english: Regional nut-in-shell season; individual cultivar maturity still needs checking.
rows.zu: Isikhathi sesifunda samantongomane asemagobolondweni; ukuvuthwa kohlobo ngalunye kusadinga ukuhlolwa.
rows.st: Nako ya sebaka ya matokomane a leng dikgetleng; ho butswa ha mofuta ka mong ho ntse ho hloka ho hlahlojwa.
rows.ts: Nguva ya xifundzha ya timanga leti nga emakambeni; ku wupfa ka muxaka wun’wana ni wun’wana ka ha fanele ku kamberiwa.
rows.ve: Khalaṅwaha ya dzingu ya nḓuhu dzi re kha maganda; u vhibva ha lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe hu kha ḓi fanela u sedzuluswa.

rows.english: Regional industry season, not a Tommy Atkins-only harvest window.
rows.zu: Isikhathi semboni sesifunda, hhayi isikhathi sesivuno se-Tommy Atkins kuphela.
rows.st: Nako ya indasteri ya sebaka, eseng nako ya kotulo ya Tommy Atkins feela.
rows.ts: Nguva ya indasitiri ya xifundzha, ku nga ri nkarhi wa ntshovelo wa Tommy Atkins ntsena.
rows.ve: Khalaṅwaha ya nḓowetshumo ya dzingu, hu si tshifhinga tsha khaṋo ya Tommy Atkins fhedzi.

rows.english: Cool subtropical KZN reference; heavier and secondary crops only.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sezindawo ezifudumele ezipholile zase-KZN; izivuno ezinkulu nezesibili kuphela.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa KZN wa sebaka sa subtropical se phodileng; dikotulo tse boima le tsa bobedi feela.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa KZN xa ndhawu ya subtropical yo titimela; mintshovelo leyikulu ni ya vumbirhi ntsena.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha KZN tsha fhethu ha subtropical hu rotholelaho; khaṋo khulwane na dza vhuvhili fhedzi.

rows.english: Spring-bearing system only; do not use this for autumn-bearing Heritage or Autumn Bliss.
rows.zu: Uhlelo oluthela entwasahlobo kuphela; ungalusebenzisi ku-Heritage noma ku-Autumn Bliss ethela ekwindla.
rows.st: Ke mokgwa o behang nakong ya selemo feela; o se ke wa o sebedisa bakeng sa Heritage kapa Autumn Bliss tse behang hwetla.
rows.ts: I maendlelo yo tswala hi ximun’wana ntsena; u nga ma tirhisi eka Heritage kumbe Autumn Bliss leti tswalaka hi xixikana.
rows.ve: Ndi sisiṱeme ya u aṋwa nga luṱavula fhedzi; ni songo i shumisa kha Heritage kana Autumn Bliss dzine dza aṋwa nga tshifhefho.

rows.english: Hex River/Wolseley trial reference; confirm cultivar, chilling and acidic soil.
rows.zu: Isikhombo socwaningo sase-Hex River/Wolseley; qinisekisa uhlobo, amakhaza adingekayo nomhlabathi one-asidi.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa teko wa Hex River/Wolseley; netefatsa mofuta, serame se hlokahalang le mobu o nang le asiti.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ndzingo xa Hex River/Wolseley; tiyisisa muxaka, xirhami ni misava ya asidi.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha ndingo tsha Hex River/Wolseley; khwaṱhisedzani lushaka, phepho na mavu a asidi.

rows.english: Breede River main-crop reference; cultivar and local dates still need checking.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sesivuno esiyinhloko sase-Breede River; uhlobo nezinsuku zendawo kusadinga ukuhlolwa.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa kotulo e kgolo wa Breede River; mofuta le matsatsi a sebaka di ntse di hloka ho hlahlojwa.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ntshovelo lowukulu xa Breede River; muxaka ni masiku ya ndhawu swa ha fanele ku kamberiwa.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha khaṋo khulwane tsha Breede River; lushaka na maḓuvha a henefho zwi kha ḓi fanela u sedzuluswa.

rows.english: Satsuma group reference; other soft-citrus varieties have different seasons.
rows.zu: Isikhombo seqembu le-Satsuma; ezinye izinhlobo ze-soft-citrus zinezikhathi ezihlukile.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sehlopha sa Satsuma; mefuta e meng ya soft-citrus e na le dinako tse fapaneng.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ntlawa wa Satsuma; mixaka yin’wana ya soft-citrus yi ni tinguva to hambana.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha tshigwada tsha Satsuma; dziṅwe tshaka dza soft-citrus dzi na khalaṅwaha dzo fhambanaho.

rows.english: SA industry reference, not a Wonderful-only window.
rows.zu: Isikhombo semboni yase-SA, hhayi isikhathi se-Wonderful kuphela.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa indasteri ya SA, eseng nako ya Wonderful feela.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa indasitiri ya SA, ku nga ri nkarhi wa Wonderful ntsena.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha nḓowetshumo ya SA, hu si tshifhinga tsha Wonderful fhedzi.

rows.english: Frost-free forest reference; confirm a fruiting female and pollen source.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sehlathi elingenasithwathwa; qinisekisa isitshalo esiyinsikazi esithelayo nomthombo wempova.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa moru o se nang serame sa lehlwa; netefatsa semela sa tshehadi se behang le mohlodi wa peo ya palesa.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa khwati leri nga riki na gwitsi; tiyisisa ximilana xa xisati lexi tswalaka ni xihlovo xa pollen.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha ḓaka ḽi si na luvhame; khwaṱhisedzani tshimela tsha tshisadzi tshi aṋwaho na tshiko tsha pollen.

rows.english: Summer-rain reference; check frost protection of young plants.
rows.zu: Isikhombo semvula yasehlobo; hlola ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo ezincane esithwathweni.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa pula ya lehlabula; hlahloba tshireletso ya dimela tse nyane kgahlanong le serame sa lehlwa.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa mpfula ya ximumu; kambela nsirhelelo wa swimila leswitsongo eka gwitsi.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha mvula ya tshilimo; sedzulusani tsireledzo ya zwimela zwiṱuku kha luvhame.

rows.english: Broad SANBI fruiting reference; local season may be shorter.
rows.zu: Isikhombo esibanzi sokuthela se-SANBI; isikhathi sendawo singaba sifushane.
rows.st: Mohlodi o pharaletseng wa SANBI wa ho beha; nako ya sebaka e ka ba kgutshwane.
rows.ts: Xikombo xo anama xa SANBI xa ku tswala; nguva ya ndhawu yi nga va yo koma.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsho ṱanḓavhuwaho tsha SANBI tsha u aṋwa; khalaṅwaha ya henefho i nga vha pfufhi.

rows.english: Fruit, not flowering; check moisture and fruiting female stock.
rows.zu: Izithelo, hhayi ukuqhakaza; hlola umswakama nezitshalo eziyinsikazi ezithelayo.
rows.st: Ditholwana, eseng ho thunya; hlahloba mongobo le dimela tsa tshehadi tse behang.
rows.ts: Mihandzu, ku nga ri ku rhumbuka; kambela ndzhongho ni swimila swa xisati leswi tswalaka.
rows.ve: Mitshelo, hu si u ṱuma maluvha; sedzulusani muṋando na zwimela zwa tshisadzi zwi aṋwaho.

rows.english: Ripe fruit only; tuberous roots are poisonous.
rows.zu: Izithelo ezivuthiwe kuphela; izimpande ezinezilimo eziyizigaxa zinobuthi.
rows.st: Ke ditholwana tse butswitseng feela; metso e metenya ya polokelo e na le tjhefo.
rows.ts: I mihandzu leyi wupfeke ntsena; timitsu leti kuleke ta vuhlayiselo ti ni chefu.
rows.ve: Ndi mitshelo yo vhibvaho fhedzi; midzi yo kukumalaho ya u vhulunga i na mulimo.

rows.english: Fruit reference, not a separate kernel season; check fruiting female stock.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sezithelo, hhayi isikhathi esihlukile sezinhlamvu zangaphakathi; hlola izitshalo eziyinsikazi ezithelayo.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa ditholwana, eseng nako e arohaneng ya thollo e ka hare; hlahloba dimela tsa tshehadi tse behang.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa mihandzu, ku nga ri nguva leyi hambaneke ya timbilu ta tindzoho; kambela swimila swa xisati leswi tswalaka.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha mitshelo, hu si khalaṅwaha yo fhambanaho ya mbilwana dza mbeu; sedzulusani zwimela zwa tshisadzi zwi aṋwaho.

rows.english: Ripe pulp only; seeds and unripe fruit are toxic.
rows.zu: Inyama yesithelo evuthiwe kuphela; imbewu nezithelo ezingakavuthwa zinobuthi.
rows.st: Ke nama ya tholwana e butswitseng feela; dipeo le ditholwana tse sa butswang di na le tjhefo.
rows.ts: I nyama ya muhandzu leyi wupfeke ntsena; timbewu ni mihandzu leyi nga wupfangiki swi ni chefu.
rows.ve: Ndi ṋama ya mutshelo yo vhibvaho fhedzi; mbeu na mitshelo i songo vhibvaho zwi na mulimo.

rows.english: Moist-position reference; fruit dates are not honey-flow dates.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sendawo enomswakama; izinsuku zezithelo akuzona izinsuku zokutholakala koju.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sebaka se mongobo; matsatsi a ditholwana ha se matsatsi a tlhahiso ya mahe a dinotshi.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ndhawu ya ndzhongho; masiku ya mihandzu a hi masiku ya vuhumelerisi bya vulombe.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha fhethu ha muṋando; maḓuvha a mitshelo a si maḓuvha a u wana mutoli.

rows.english: Northern production-region reference, not the national November–May union.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sesifunda sokukhiqiza sasenyakatho, hhayi ukuhlanganiswa kukaNovemba–Meyi kuzwelonke.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sebaka sa tlhahiso sa leboya, eseng kopanyo ya naha ya Pudungwana–Motsheanong.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa xifundzha xa vuhumelerisi xa le n’walungwini, ku nga ri ku hlanganisiwa ka Hukuri–Mudyaxihi ka tiko.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha dzingu ḽa mveledzo ḽa devhula, hu si u ṱanganyiswa ha Lara–Shundunthule ha lushaka.
